latestVersion.changelog:
Wan AI Leading AI Video Generation Model — Initial Release

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from text or image prompts via a cloud-based pipeline.
- Supports file uploads (MP4, PNG, JPG, WebM up to 200MB) and returns processed video within 1-3 minutes.
- Provides session-based workflow with automatic backend connection and authentication handling (including free trial credits).
- User prompts are auto-classified for actions like video generation, export, checking credits, and uploading files.
- Includes robust handling for API response translation, draft timelines, status tracking, error codes, and export attribution.
- Designed for content creators, marketers, and filmmakers seeking fast and simple text-to-video creation.
